summary.text: Joe Martin (listed on Ballotpedia as Joseph E. Martin) is a Republican state senator who has represented Maine Senate District 19 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. His career includes work as a miner and as a chief operating officer.

paragraphs.text: Martin earned a high school diploma from Mexico High School in 1972.
His career experience includes serving as a COO, serving on the boards of several publicly traded companies, and working as a miner.
Martin assumed office in the Maine State Senate on December 3, 2024, succeeding Lisa Keim, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
